label: 掃描找蘑菇
title: 草叢掃描弧
subject: a squat coral-red mushroom with a plain cream stem peeking out from one simple low sage-green leaf clump, with one broad smooth honey-gold scanning arc sweeping above the cap, separated by a small clear gap. Arc is a solid soft matte clay form, not a glowing neon beam, no transparency glow, no extra concentric arcs

mechanical_operations.operation: Uniform scale and translate complete RGBA image to center alpha128 body with about 8% safe margin; no shape edits

alpha_policy: Original alpha retained; no shape edits, morphological filters, recoloring, thickening or outline added.
limitations: Generated soft shading and edge alpha require visual review.
20dp/24dp browser mockups are not Android device tests.
